title: AT&T Pogo
summary: AT&T Pogo was a discontinued, Firefox-based web browser developed by AT&T and Vizible. It entered private beta with features including multiple homepage support, visual tab thumbnails, visual bookmark and history management, and a searchable bookmark/history feature. The project ended when Vizible sold its intellectual property to Open Text.

mechanisms.title: Visual tab management
mechanisms.explanation: Displayed thumbnail previews for each open tab, allowing users to visually identify and switch between pages.

mechanisms.title: Visual bookmark and history management
mechanisms.explanation: Provided visual interfaces for managing bookmarks and browsing history, including a search feature to locate specific items.
